state.background: Review the final corrected implementation checkpoint P42-191. In the dark-mode/text-zoom mobile browser test, replace a tooltip-wide `/\d/` assertion—which could be satisfied by the total/headline—with a locator restricted to `[data-tooltip-row="true"]`, filtered by `/\d/`, and assert the first matching numeric category row is visible. The actual first category row may validly be `対象期間外` with no numeric value, so the numeric check selects the first category row that does contain a digit. P42-189/P42-190 checks remain on the first actual category row for visibility and nonempty text. P42-192 still clicks close and asserts the tooltip is hidden; tooltip visibility, real tap, dark theme and text zoom remain. Existing `CustomTooltip.test.tsx` T2/T3 covers numeric formatting/total and full payload; component/other browser coverage checks right alignment. Do not claim those unit tests prove selected-chart mapping: this P42-191 browser check confirms a numeric value exists on the selected nominal chart's category row. The initial failed version requiring a numeric first row was corrected after observing `対象期間外`; that obsolete run is superseded and is not evidence. The final code and exact ledger mapping are reviewed below.
